title: Explained anomaly detection in text reviews: Can subjective scenarios be correctly evaluated?
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis. The findings focus on the performance of anomaly detection models on text reviews and the perceived usefulness of different AI-based explanation techniques.
